cache_policy: exact-key in-memory result cache; availability never triggers expensive work; fixture records are deterministic cache sources; corruption fails loudly as 503
disagreement_definitions: signed_gap simulation_minus_model; absolute_gap; descending average ranks + rank_displacement simulation_minus_model; tie-safe leader sets + exact_leader_match; top-k boundary-tie WIN-ranking overlap + jaccard; SE + Wilson 95% labelled FINITE_MC_SAMPLING_CONTEXT_ONLY (all C implementations verbatim)
e_gate: FUSION_IMPROVEMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED (no fused probability exists; runtime fusion path absent by architecture)
known_limitations: demonstration fixtures cover exactly 2 anchors; live provider wiring is deployment integration, not research
fixture state_time_s null (D records carry race+lap identity; T equality enforced on available keys)
comparison requires >=2 common drivers for rank/leader/top-k blocks
in-memory cache is per-process (no shared TTL store)
mc_sampling_interpretation: finite-MC sampling context only; never model confidence, total/real-world uncertainty, or significance
next_stage_readiness: stable contract + deterministic fixtures ready for V3.8G UI; no visual work in F
probability_family_semantics: V3_1B_LOGISTIC INDEPENDENT_BINARY WIN (raw, never race-normalized) vs MC2_E MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_SIMULATION_FREQUENCY WIN (never reinterpreted as Logistic-family)
prohibited_fusion_semantics: no fused/consensus/combined/ensemble/recommended probability, no runtime alpha/blend/weighted_average, no confidence/consensus score (tested in code and on the wire)
prohibited_source_winner_semantics: no preferred/winning source, recommendation, trust scores, or quality scores; product exposes evidence only
refusal_error_policy: 404 unknown_race; 422 unknown_state / consensus_unsupported(reason+detail); 503 parameter_unavailable on corruption; 500 internal otherwise; no stack traces/paths/internals
support_semantics: per-source AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE with B ReasonCode; COMPARABLE only when both AVAILABLE; supported MC2 zero stays numeric 0.0; missing stays null/absent
temporal_alignment_semantics: exact (race_id, anchor_lap_number, anchor_state_time_s) identity; B exact-identity alignment; no interpolation/future/fill; no outcome labels or D/E ground truth in runtime
validation_results: 39/39 focused F tests pass; subsystem + targeted A/B/C/D/E regression run separately
year_policy_2025: REVEALED_HOLDOUT / NON_PRISTINE / PRODUCT_EXCLUDED: UNAVAILABLE/NOT_COMPARABLE availability, 422 STATE_NOT_AVAILABLE compare refusal
